answer: Bonded escrows make each identity accountable: when evidence links k coordinated identities to equivocation, the penalty grows with the number of implicated pairs, O(k²), rather than treating each claim independently. Detection also applies an exp(αk) loss multiplier to exposed collateral, with α>0, so a sybil swarm risks exponentially greater capital loss. Correlation checks across comet, wharf, and saffron domains help expose coordination; asymmetric depreciation prevents withdrawn or surviving stake from undoing the slash.
